hookups.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234180 (notice: 'No sewer, water or electric hookups available; no dumping of black or gray water permitted anywhere except at dump station') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/northcarolina/recreation/jackrabbit-mountain-rec-area-campground ('no hook-ups are available'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Forest Service: 100 wooded sites in three loops, most with views of Lake Chatuge; 'Several sites in Loops A and B can accommodate RVs'. recreation.gov's catalog lists 92 (70 standard, 22 RV), 21 of them pull-through; listed max vehicle lengths run 22-80 ft (a few 100-128 ft entries look like errors). Sites typed RV have no tent pads.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/northcarolina/recreation/jackrabbit-mountain-rec-area-campground ('Three campground loops offer 100 wooded sites') + RIDB catalog 234180 ('Driveway Entry': 21 Pull-Through, 71 Back-In; 'Max Vehicle Length') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234180 notice ('Campsites identified as RV sites do not have tent pads'), read 2026-10-22

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/northcarolina/recreation/jackrabbit-mountain-rec-area-campground ('Accessible flush toilets, hot showers and drinking water are available'; 'Registered campers may access the on-site RV dump station'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Loop A is open May - September; Loops B and C May - October.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/northcarolina/recreation/jackrabbit-mountain-rec-area-campground ('Closed seasonally on the following dates: Campground: November 1st- April 30th') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234180 overview ('Loops A is open May - September, and Loop B and C is open May - October'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 'All sites (Loop A, Loop B, and Loop C) must be reserved through recreation.gov. There are no first come first serve sites available ... Reservations can be made up to the day of arrival.' 14 nights in a rolling 30 days. Check-in 4 pm, check-out noon.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234180 (notices; facility_rules maxStay 14 'Rolling 30 Days', maxConsecutiveStay 14) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/northcarolina/recreation/jackrabbit-mountain-rec-area-campground ('Reservations are required'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: $20 a night for a single site, $40 for a double. Parking at the beach is $5 per vehicle per day, registered campers included.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/northcarolina/recreation/jackrabbit-mountain-rec-area-campground ('Overnight Use: $20 a night for single sites; $40 a night for double sites') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234180/rates (Peak Season 2026-05-01 to 2026-10-01: RV NONELECTRIC and STANDARD NONELECTRIC $20) + notice on the $5 beach fee, read 2026-10-22

note: USFS Nantahala NF (Tusquitee RD) on a peninsula of Lake Chatuge near Hayesville. Wooded loops, most sites with lake views; the RV-sized sites are in Loops A and B. Swim beach, boat ramp, fishing pier, 15-mile mountain-bike trail system. --Claude
summary: Forest Service-run, reservation-only on recreation.gov, 'Site Open' on the FS page; no Helene alert. Confirmed no hookups, dump station, 100 sites (FS), $20. Added season May 1 - Oct 31 (Loop A to September), showers, flush toilets, drinking water, pull-throughs, no FCFS, same-day booking, 14-night max, double sites $40. Not stated: a single max rig length (catalog lengths are per site). recreation.gov's holiday-weekend minimum is 0 (soft, ended 2024), so no minimum recorded.
flags: Waterfront re-audit lead: entry is 'lakeview'; recreation.gov says 'three loops of well-kept campsites, some of which lie on the water's edge' (the FS page says 'most of which provide views of Lake Chatuge'). Not changed.
Site count: Forest Service page says 100 sites; recreation.gov's catalog lists 92. Kept 100 with both in sites.note.
